description: Election Commission - D. M. S. K. Dissanayaka Was Elected as the Member of the Rambewa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Rambewa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a replacement member through the recognized political party and the formal declaration of election by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government member appointments, falling clearly under the Elections category.
